(function(){
'use strict';
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s);
const D=R.days, N=R.d.length, NS=R.src.length, NP=R.pages.length, NC=R.countries.length;
const A_d=Int16Array.from(R.d), A_s=Uint8Array.from(R.s), A_p=Uint8Array.from(R.p), A_c=Uint8Array.from(R.c),
      A_v=Uint8Array.from(R.v), A_st=Uint8Array.from(R.st), A_du=Uint16Array.from(R.du), A_vi=Int32Array.from(R.vi), A_r=Float32Array.from(R.r);
let NV=0; for(let i=0;i<N;i++) if(A_vi[i]>NV) NV=A_vi[i]; NV++;
const dayStart=new Int32Array(D+1);
{ let k=0; for(let d=0;d<=D;d++){ while(k<N && A_d[k]<d) k++; dayStart[d]=k; } }
const [Y0,M0,D0]=R.start.split('-').map(Number), T0=Date.UTC(Y0,M0-1,D0);
const MON=['Jan','Feb','Mar','Apr','May','Jun','Jul','Aug','Sep','Oct','Nov','Dec'];
const dateOf=i=>new Date(T0+i*864e5);
const dl=(i,y)=>{const x=dateOf(i);return x.getUTCDate()+' '+MON[x.getUTCMonth()]+(y?' '+x.getUTCFullYear():'')};
const iso=i=>dateOf(i).toISOString().slice(0,10);
const fmt=n=>Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US');
const pct=(x,d=1)=>(x*100).toFixed(d)+'%';
const usd=n=>'$'+Math.round(n).toLocaleString('en-US');
const mmss=s=>{s=Math.round(s);return Math.floor(s/60)+':'+String(s%60).padStart(2,'0')};
const sd=(a,b)=>b?a/b:0;
const SCOL=['var(--s1)','var(--s2)','var(--s3)','var(--s4)','var(--s5)'];
const DEFAULT_LEN=30;

const S={r0:D-DEFAULT_LEN,r1:D-1,dev:-1,src:new Set(),srcMask:new Uint8Array(NS),ctry:-1,mapM:'sessions',sort:{k:'n',dir:-1},logPage:0};
let RES=null;

/* ---------- compute ---------- */
function compute(o){
  const r0=o.r0===undefined?0:o.r0, r1=o.r1===undefined?D-1:o.r1;
  const f=n=>new Float64Array(n);
  const res={n:0,b:0,cv:0,rev:0,dur:0,uv:0,se:f(6),stage:f(6),sn:f(NS),sb:f(NS),sc:f(NS),
    cn:f(NC),cb:f(NC),cc:f(NC),cr:f(NC),pn:f(NP),pb:f(NP),pc:f(NP),pr:f(NP),pd:f(NP),
    dn:f(D),db:f(D),dc:f(D),dr:f(D),dv:f(D),idx:o.idx?[]:null};
  const seen=o.uv?new Uint8Array(NV):null, last=o.vis?new Int16Array(NV).fill(-1):null;
  const hasS=o.src&&S.src.size>0, dv=(o.dev&&S.dev>=0)?S.dev:-1, cf=(o.ctry&&S.ctry>=0)?S.ctry:-1, sm=S.srcMask;
  for(let i=dayStart[r0];i<dayStart[r1+1];i++){
    if(dv>=0&&A_v[i]!==dv) continue;
    if(hasS&&!sm[A_s[i]]) continue;
    if(cf>=0&&A_c[i]!==cf) continue;
    const st=A_st[i], d=A_d[i], s=A_s[i], c=A_c[i], p=A_p[i];
    const bo=st===0?1:0, cv=st===5?1:0, rv=A_r[i], du=A_du[i];
    res.n++; res.b+=bo; res.cv+=cv; res.rev+=rv; res.dur+=du; res.se[st]++;
    res.sn[s]++; res.sb[s]+=bo; res.sc[s]+=cv;
    res.cn[c]++; res.cb[c]+=bo; res.cc[c]+=cv; res.cr[c]+=rv;
    res.pn[p]++; res.pb[p]+=bo; res.pc[p]+=cv; res.pr[p]+=rv; res.pd[p]+=du;
    res.dn[d]++; res.db[d]+=bo; res.dc[d]+=cv; res.dr[d]+=rv;
    if(seen&&!seen[A_vi[i]]){seen[A_vi[i]]=1;res.uv++}
    if(last&&last[A_vi[i]]!==d){last[A_vi[i]]=d;res.dv[d]++}
    if(res.idx) res.idx.push(i);
  }
  let acc=0; for(let k=5;k>=0;k--){acc+=res.se[k];res.stage[k]=acc}
  return res;
}
function update(){
  S.srcMask.fill(0); S.src.forEach(i=>S.srcMask[i]=1);
  const len=S.r1-S.r0+1, p0=S.r0-len;
  RES={
    full:compute({r0:S.r0,r1:S.r1,src:1,dev:1,ctry:1,uv:1,idx:1}),
    prior:p0>=0?compute({r0:p0,r1:S.r0-1,src:1,dev:1,ctry:1,uv:1}):null,
    trend:compute({src:1,dev:1,ctry:1,vis:1}),
    noSrc:compute({r0:S.r0,r1:S.r1,dev:1,ctry:1}),
    noCtry:compute({r0:S.r0,r1:S.r1,src:1,dev:1}),
    len
  };
  drawAll();
}

/* ---------- tooltip ---------- */
const tipEl=$('#tip');
function tip(html,e){
  tipEl.innerHTML=html; tipEl.style.opacity=1;
  const w=tipEl.offsetWidth,h=tipEl.offsetHeight; let x=e.clientX+14,y=e.clientY+14;
  if(x+w>innerWidth-8)x=e.clientX-w-14; if(y+h>innerHeight-8)y=e.clientY-h-14;
  tipEl.style.left=Math.max(8,x)+'px'; tipEl.style.top=Math.max(8,y)+'px';
}
const untip=()=>{tipEl.style.opacity=0};
const trow=(a,b)=>`<div class="r"><span>${a}</span><span>${b}</span></div>`;

/* ---------- header + filters ---------- */
function drawBar(){
  $('#sub').textContent=`${fmt(N)} sessions · ${dl(0,1)} to ${dl(D-1,1)} · generated sample data`;
  const len=S.r1-S.r0+1, preset=S.r1===D-1&&[7,30,90,180].includes(len);
  document.querySelectorAll('#rangeSeg button').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',preset&&+b.dataset.r===len?'true':'false'));
  document.querySelectorAll('#devSeg button').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',+b.dataset.d===S.dev?'true':'false'));
  document.querySelectorAll('#mapSeg button').forEach(b=>b.setAttribute('aria-pressed',b.dataset.m===S.mapM?'true':'false'));
  const act=[];
  if(!preset) act.push(`<span class="chip">${dl(S.r0)} – ${dl(S.r1,1)}<button data-clear="range" aria-label="Clear custom period">×</button></span>`);
  S.src.forEach(i=>act.push(`<span class="chip"><span class="dot" style="background:${SCOL[i]}"></span>${R.src[i]}<button data-clear="src" data-i="${i}" aria-label="Remove ${R.src[i]}">×</button></span>`));
  if(S.ctry>=0) act.push(`<span class="chip">${R.countries[S.ctry].n}<button data-clear="ctry" aria-label="Clear country">×</button></span>`);
  const a=$('#active'); a.hidden=!act.length; a.innerHTML=act.length?`<span>Filtering by</span>${act.join('')}`:'';
  const dirty=!preset||len!==DEFAULT_LEN||S.dev>=0||S.src.size>0||S.ctry>=0;
  $('#reset').hidden=!dirty;
}

/* ---------- KPIs ---------- */
function spark(arr,r0,r1){
  const v=Array.from(arr.slice(r0,r1+1)); const W=200,H=30,pad=3;
  if(v.length<2) return '';
  const mn=Math.min(...v),mx=Math.max(...v),rg=(mx-mn)||1;
  const pts=v.map((y,i)=>[pad+(W-2*pad)*i/(v.length-1),H-pad-(H-2*pad)*(y-mn)/rg]);
  const d='M'+pts.map(p=>p[0].toFixed(1)+','+p[1].toFixed(1)).join('L');
  const e=pts[pts.length-1];
  return `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" preserveAspectRatio="none" aria-hidden="true"><path d="${d}" fill="none" stroke="var(--s1)" stroke-width="1.6" vector-effect="non-scaling-stroke" stroke-linejoin="round"/><circle cx="${e[0]}" cy="${e[1]}" r="0" /></svg>`;
}
function drawKPIs(){
  const F=RES.full,P=RES.prior,r0=S.r0,r1=S.r1;
  const ratio=(a,b)=>a.map((x,i)=>sd(x,b[i]));
  const defs=[
    {k:'Visitors',v:F.uv,p:P&&P.uv,f:fmt,s:RES.trend.dv,rel:1,good:1},
    {k:'Sessions',v:F.n,p:P&&P.n,f:fmt,s:RES.trend.dn,rel:1,good:1},
    {k:'Bounce rate',v:sd(F.b,F.n),p:P&&sd(P.b,P.n),f:x=>pct(x),s:ratio(RES.trend.db,RES.trend.dn),rel:0,good:-1},
    {k:'Conversion rate',v:sd(F.cv,F.n),p:P&&sd(P.cv,P.n),f:x=>pct(x,2),s:ratio(RES.trend.dc,RES.trend.dn),rel:0,good:1},
    {k:'Revenue',v:F.rev,p:P&&P.rev,f:usd,s:RES.trend.dr,rel:1,good:1}
  ];
  $('#kpis').innerHTML=defs.map(d=>{
    let delta='<span>no earlier period to compare</span>';
    if(P&&d.p!==null&&d.p!==undefined&&(d.p>0||d.v>0)){
      const diff=d.rel?(d.p?(d.v-d.p)/d.p:0):(d.v-d.p), up=diff>=0;
      const txt=d.rel?pct(Math.abs(diff)):(Math.abs(diff)*100).toFixed(2)+' pts';
      const flat=Math.abs(diff)<(d.rel?0.005:0.0005);
      const cls=flat?'':((up?1:-1)*d.good>0?'good':'bad');
      delta=`<b class="${cls}">${flat?'■':(up?'▲':'▼')} ${txt}</b><span>vs previous ${RES.len} days</span>`;
    }
    return `<div class="kpi"><div class="k">${d.k}</div><div class="v">${F.n?d.f(d.v):'—'}</div><div class="d">${delta}</div>${spark(d.s,r0,r1)}</div>`;
  }).join('');
}

/* ---------- trend ---------- */
function niceMax(v){const p=Math.pow(10,Math.floor(Math.log10(v||1)));const m=v/p;return (m<=1?1:m<=2?2:m<=2.5?2.5:m<=5?5:10)*p}
let brush=null;
function drawTrend(){
  const el=$('#trend'),W=Math.max(300,el.clientWidth),H=W<520?240:300,m={l:44,r:12,t:16,b:28};
  const T=RES.trend, vis=T.dv, ma=new Array(D).fill(null);
  for(let i=6;i<D;i++){let s=0;for(let k=0;k<7;k++)s+=vis[i-k];ma[i]=s/7}
  let mx=0,mi=0;for(let i=0;i<D;i++)if(vis[i]>mx){mx=vis[i];mi=i}
  const ymax=niceMax(mx*1.12), iw=W-m.l-m.r, ih=H-m.t-m.b;
  const x=i=>m.l+iw*i/(D-1), y=v=>m.t+ih*(1-v/ymax);
  const step=iw/(D-1);
  let g='',xt='';
  for(let k=0;k<=4;k++){const v=ymax*k/4;g+=`<line x1="${m.l}" x2="${W-m.r}" y1="${y(v)}" y2="${y(v)}" stroke="var(--grid)" stroke-width="1"/><text x="${m.l-8}" y="${y(v)+4}" text-anchor="end">${fmt(v)}</text>`}
  for(let i=0;i<D;i++){const dd=dateOf(i);if(dd.getUTCDate()===1||i===0){const lab=i===0?dl(i):MON[dd.getUTCMonth()];if((i===0&&W>=520)||i>8)xt+=`<text x="${x(i)}" y="${H-8}" text-anchor="${i===0?'start':'middle'}">${lab}</text>`}}
  const line=a=>{let d='',pen=false;a.forEach((v,i)=>{if(v===null){pen=false;return}d+=(pen?'L':'M')+x(i).toFixed(1)+','+y(v).toFixed(1);pen=true});return d};
  const area=line(vis)+`L${x(D-1)},${y(0)}L${x(0)},${y(0)}Z`;
  const sx0=x(S.r0)-step/2, sx1=x(S.r1)+step/2;
  const pk=x(mi), pkLab=`Peak ${fmt(mx)} · ${dl(mi)}`;
  const anchor=pk>W-110?'end':(pk<m.l+60?'start':'middle');
  el.innerHTML=`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" width="${W}" height="${H}" role="img" aria-label="Daily visitors with 7-day moving average">
    ${g}${xt}
    <path d="${area}" fill="var(--raw)" opacity=".14"/>
    <path d="${line(vis)}" fill="none" stroke="var(--raw)" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <path d="${line(ma)}" fill="none" stroke="var(--s1)" stroke-width="2.75" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="${pk}" cy="${y(mx)}" r="3.5" fill="var(--surface)" stroke="var(--raw)" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="${pk}" y="${y(mx)-9}" text-anchor="${anchor}" class="t-ink2">${pkLab}</text>
    <rect x="${m.l}" y="${m.t}" width="${Math.max(0,sx0-m.l)}" height="${ih}" fill="var(--surface)" opacity=".6"/>
    <rect x="${sx1}" y="${m.t}" width="${Math.max(0,W-m.r-sx1)}" height="${ih}" fill="var(--surface)" opacity=".6"/>
    <line x1="${sx0}" x2="${sx0}" y1="${m.t}" y2="${m.t+ih}" stroke="var(--ink2)" stroke-width="1" opacity=".35" ${S.r0===0?'visibility="hidden"':''}/>
    <line x1="${sx1}" x2="${sx1}" y1="${m.t}" y2="${m.t+ih}" stroke="var(--ink2)" stroke-width="1" opacity=".35" ${S.r1===D-1?'visibility="hidden"':''}/>
    <rect id="bsel" y="${m.t}" height="${ih}" fill="var(--accent)" opacity=".2" visibility="hidden"/>
    <g id="hv" visibility="hidden"><line id="hvl" y1="${m.t}" y2="${m.t+ih}" stroke="var(--ink2)" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="3 3"/><circle id="hv1" r="4" fill="var(--surface)" stroke="var(--raw)" stroke-width="2"/><circle id="hv2" r="4.5" fill="var(--surface)" stroke="var(--s1)" stroke-width="2.5"/></g>
    <rect id="ov" x="${m.l}" y="${m.t}" width="${iw}" height="${ih}" fill="transparent"/>
  </svg>`;
  const svg=el.querySelector('svg'),ov=svg.querySelector('#ov'),hv=svg.querySelector('#hv'),bsel=svg.querySelector('#bsel');
  const idxAt=e=>{const r=svg.getBoundingClientRect();const px=(e.clientX-r.left)*(W/r.width);return Math.max(0,Math.min(D-1,Math.round((px-m.l)/iw*(D-1))))};
  const show=(e,i)=>{
    hv.setAttribute('visibility','visible');
    hv.querySelector('#hvl').setAttribute('x1',x(i));hv.querySelector('#hvl').setAttribute('x2',x(i));
    const c1=hv.querySelector('#hv1');c1.setAttribute('cx',x(i));c1.setAttribute('cy',y(vis[i]));
    const c2=hv.querySelector('#hv2');if(ma[i]===null){c2.setAttribute('visibility','hidden')}else{c2.setAttribute('visibility','visible');c2.setAttribute('cx',x(i));c2.setAttribute('cy',y(ma[i]))}
    const wd=['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'][dateOf(i).getUTCDay()];
    tip(`<div class="h">${wd} ${dl(i,1)}</div>${trow('Visitors',fmt(vis[i]))}${trow('7-day average',ma[i]===null?'—':fmt(ma[i]))}${trow('Sessions',fmt(T.dn[i]))}${trow('Bounce rate',T.dn[i]?pct(T.db[i]/T.dn[i]):'—')}`,e);
  };
  ov.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{
    const i=idxAt(e);
    if(brush){brush.b=i;const a=Math.min(brush.a,brush.b),b=Math.max(brush.a,brush.b);bsel.setAttribute('visibility','visible');bsel.setAttribute('x',x(a)-step/2);bsel.setAttribute('width',(b-a+1)*step);
      tip(`<div class="h">${dl(a)} – ${dl(b,1)}</div>${trow('Days',b-a+1)}<div style="opacity:.75;margin-top:2px">Release to apply</div>`,e);return}
    show(e,i);
  });
  ov.addEventListener('pointerleave',()=>{if(!brush){hv.setAttribute('visibility','hidden');untip()}});
  ov.addEventListener('pointerdown',e=>{brush={a:idxAt(e),b:idxAt(e)};hv.setAttribute('visibility','hidden');try{ov.setPointerCapture(e.pointerId)}catch(_){}});
  const end=()=>{
    if(!brush)return;const a=Math.min(brush.a,brush.b),b=Math.max(brush.a,brush.b);brush=null;untip();
    if(b-a>=2){S.r0=a;S.r1=b;S.logPage=0;update()}else{bsel.setAttribute('visibility','hidden')}
  };
  ov.addEventListener('pointerup',end);ov.addEventListener('pointercancel',()=>{brush=null;untip()});
  $('#trendSub').textContent=`Unique visitors per day, ${dl(0)} to ${dl(D-1,1)}. Shaded edges fall outside the selected period.`;
}

/* ---------- sources ---------- */
function arcPath(cx,cy,r0,r1,a0,a1){
  const L=a1-a0>Math.PI?1:0,p=(r,a)=>[(cx+r*Math.sin(a)).toFixed(2),(cy-r*Math.cos(a)).toFixed(2)];
  const A=p(r1,a0),B=p(r1,a1),C=p(r0,a1),Dd=p(r0,a0);
  return `M${A}A${r1},${r1} 0 ${L} 1 ${B}L${C}A${r0},${r0} 0 ${L} 0 ${Dd}Z`;
}
function toggleSrc(i){
  if(S.src.size===0){S.src.add(i)}else if(S.src.has(i)){S.src.delete(i)}else{S.src.add(i)}
  S.logPage=0;update();
}
function drawSources(){
  const X=RES.noSrc,tot=X.n,Z=200,cx=Z/2,cy=Z/2,r1=92,r0=62;
  let a=0,paths='';
  const dim=i=>S.src.size>0&&!S.src.has(i);
  for(let i=0;i<NS;i++){
    const f=sd(X.sn[i],tot);if(!f)continue;const a0=a,a1=a+f*Math.PI*2;a=a1;
    const g=f>0.02?0.018:0;
    paths+=`<path data-i="${i}" d="${arcPath(cx,cy,r0,r1,a0+g,a1-g)}" style="fill:${SCOL[i]};opacity:${dim(i)?.28:1};cursor:pointer"/>`;
  }
  $('#donut').innerHTML=`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${Z} ${Z}" width="${Z}" height="${Z}" style="max-width:100%" role="img" aria-label="Traffic source share">${paths}
    <text x="${cx}" y="${cy-2}" text-anchor="middle" class="t-ink" style="font-size:25px;font-weight:650;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums">${fmt(tot)}</text>
    <text x="${cx}" y="${cy+16}" text-anchor="middle">sessions</text></svg>`;
  const svg=$('#donut svg');
  svg.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const t=e.target.closest('[data-i]');if(!t){untip();return}const i=+t.dataset.i;
    tip(`<div class="h"><span class="dot" style="background:${SCOL[i]}"></span>${R.src[i]}</div>${trow('Sessions',fmt(X.sn[i]))}${trow('Share',pct(sd(X.sn[i],tot)))}${trow('Bounce rate',pct(sd(X.sb[i],X.sn[i])))}${trow('Conversion',pct(sd(X.sc[i],X.sn[i]),2))}`,e)});
  svg.addEventListener('mouseleave',untip);
  svg.addEventListener('click',e=>{const t=e.target.closest('[data-i]');if(t){untip();toggleSrc(+t.dataset.i)}});
  const order=[...Array(NS).keys()].sort((p,q)=>X.sn[q]-X.sn[p]);
  const mx=Math.max(1,...Array.from(X.sn));
  $('#srcList').innerHTML=order.map(i=>`<button class="row" data-s="${i}" aria-pressed="${S.src.has(i)}" style="opacity:${dim(i)?.55:1}">
    <span class="nm"><span class="dot" style="background:${SCOL[i]}"></span>${R.src[i]}</span><span class="vals mono">${fmt(X.sn[i])}</span><span class="sh mono">${pct(sd(X.sn[i],tot))}</span>
    <span class="meter"><i style="width:${X.sn[i]/mx*100}%;background:${SCOL[i]}"></i></span></button>`).join('');
}

/* ---------- bounce by source ---------- */
function drawBounce(){
  const X=RES.noSrc,avg=sd(X.b,X.n);
  const rates=[...Array(NS).keys()].filter(i=>X.sn[i]>0).map(i=>({i,r:sd(X.sb[i],X.sn[i])})).sort((p,q)=>q.r-p.r);
  const scale=Math.min(1,Math.max(.5,Math.ceil((Math.max(0,...rates.map(o=>o.r))+.05)*10)/10));
  $('#bounce').innerHTML=rates.map(o=>`<div class="brow" data-i="${o.i}" style="opacity:${S.src.size&&!S.src.has(o.i)?.4:1}"><div class="nm"><span class="dot" style="background:${SCOL[o.i]}"></span>${R.src[o.i]}</div>
    <div class="trk"><i style="width:${o.r/scale*100}%;background:${SCOL[o.i]}"></i></div><div class="val mono">${pct(o.r)}</div></div>`).join('')
    +`<div class="avg"><b style="left:${avg/scale*100}%"></b><em style="left:${avg/scale*100}%">Overall ${pct(avg)}</em></div>`;
  const root=$('#bounce');
  root.onmousemove=e=>{const t=e.target.closest('.brow');if(!t){untip();return}const i=+t.dataset.i;
    tip(`<div class="h"><span class="dot" style="background:${SCOL[i]}"></span>${R.src[i]}</div>${trow('Bounce rate',pct(sd(X.sb[i],X.sn[i])))}${trow('Bounced',fmt(X.sb[i]))}${trow('Sessions',fmt(X.sn[i]))}${trow('vs overall',((sd(X.sb[i],X.sn[i])-avg)*100>=0?'+':'')+((sd(X.sb[i],X.sn[i])-avg)*100).toFixed(1)+' pts')}`,e)};
  root.onmouseleave=untip;
}

/* ---------- funnel ---------- */
function drawFunnel(){
  const F=RES.full,el=$('#funnel'),W=Math.max(300,el.clientWidth),rowH=58,gap=0,H=rowH*6+8;
  const lab=W<430?118:150,ax=lab+8,aw=W-ax-4,cx=ax+aw/2;
  const st=F.stage,top=st[0]||1;
  const wOf=k=>Math.max(6,aw*(st[k]/top));
  let svg='';
  for(let k=0;k<6;k++){
    const y=k*rowH+4,bh=36,w=wOf(k);
    if(k<5){const w2=wOf(k+1);svg+=`<path d="M${cx-w/2},${y+bh}L${cx+w/2},${y+bh}L${cx+w2/2},${y+rowH}L${cx-w2/2},${y+rowH}Z" style="fill:var(--f${k});opacity:.22"/>`}
    svg+=`<rect data-k="${k}" x="${cx-w/2}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="${bh}" rx="4" style="fill:var(--f${k});cursor:default"/>`;
    const step=k?sd(st[k],st[k-1]):1;
    svg+=`<text x="0" y="${y+14}" class="t-ink" style="font-weight:600;font-size:12.5px">${R.stages[k]}</text>
      <text x="0" y="${y+30}" class="mono" style="font-size:11.5px">${fmt(st[k])} · ${pct(sd(st[k],top),k>=4?2:1)}</text>`;
    if(k) svg+=`<text x="${ax+aw}" y="${y-5}" text-anchor="end" style="font-size:11px">${pct(step)} continue</text>`;
  }
  el.innerHTML=`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" width="${W}" height="${H}" role="img" aria-label="Conversion funnel">${svg}</svg>`;
  const root=el.querySelector('svg');
  root.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const t=e.target.closest('[data-k]');if(!t){untip();return}const k=+t.dataset.k;
    tip(`<div class="h">${R.stages[k]}</div>${trow('Sessions',fmt(st[k]))}${trow('Of all sessions',pct(sd(st[k],top),2))}${k?trow('From previous step',pct(sd(st[k],st[k-1]),1)):''}${k?trow('Lost at this step',fmt(st[k-1]-st[k])):''}`,e)});
  root.addEventListener('mouseleave',untip);
}

/* ---------- map ---------- */
function ne1(lon,lat){const l=lon*Math.PI/180,p=lat*Math.PI/180,p2=p*p,p4=p2*p2;
  return [l*(0.8707-0.131979*p2+p4*(-0.013791+p4*(0.003971*p2-0.001529*p4))),p*(1.007226+p2*(0.015085+p4*(-0.044475+0.028874*p2-0.005916*p4)))]}
const LAT_T=84,LAT_B=-57,XMAX=ne1(180,0)[0],YT=ne1(0,LAT_T)[1],YB=ne1(0,LAT_B)[1];
function hex(c){c=c.trim();if(c[0]!=='#')return[128,128,128];if(c.length===4)c='#'+c[1]+c[1]+c[2]+c[2]+c[3]+c[3];return[1,3,5].map(i=>parseInt(c.substr(i,2),16))}
function ramp(t){
  const cs=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement),q=[0,1,2,3,4,5,6].map(i=>hex(cs.getPropertyValue('--q'+i)));
  t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,t))*6;const i=Math.min(5,Math.floor(t)),f=t-i;
  return 'rgb('+[0,1,2].map(k=>Math.round(q[i][k]+(q[i+1][k]-q[i][k])*f)).join(',')+')';
}
function drawMap(){
  const X=RES.noCtry,el=$('#map'),W=Math.max(300,el.clientWidth),pad=6,sc=(W-2*pad)/(2*XMAX),H=(YT-YB)*sc+2*pad;
  const P=(lon,lat)=>{const [a,b]=ne1(lon,lat);return [pad+(a+XMAX)*sc,pad+(YT-b)*sc]};
  const poly=ps=>'M'+ps.map(p=>P(p[0],p[1]).map(v=>v.toFixed(1)).join(',')).join('L')+'Z';
  const land=LAND.map(poly).join(''),water=WATER.map(poly).join('');
  const M=S.mapM,MINN=40;
  const val=c=>M==='sessions'?X.cn[c]:M==='conv'?sd(X.cc[c],X.cn[c]):sd(X.cb[c],X.cn[c]);
  const ok=[];for(let c=0;c<NC;c++)if(X.cn[c]>=MINN)ok.push(val(c));
  const lo=ok.length?Math.min(...ok):0,hi=ok.length?Math.max(...ok):1;
  const maxN=Math.max(1,...Array.from(X.cn)),Rmax=Math.max(14,Math.min(34,W*.04));
  const order=[...Array(NC).keys()].filter(c=>X.cn[c]>0).sort((a,b)=>X.cn[b]-X.cn[a]);
  const colour=c=>{if(M==='sessions')return 'var(--s1)';if(X.cn[c]<MINN)return 'var(--nodata)';return ramp(hi===lo?.5:(val(c)-lo)/(hi-lo))};
  let b='',lbl='';
  order.forEach((c,rank)=>{const C=R.countries[c],[px,py]=P(C.lon,C.lat),r=3+Math.sqrt(X.cn[c]/maxN)*Rmax,sel=S.ctry===c,dim=S.ctry>=0&&!sel;
    b+=`<circle class="bub" data-c="${c}" cx="${px.toFixed(1)}" cy="${py.toFixed(1)}" r="${r.toFixed(1)}" style="fill:${colour(c)};fill-opacity:${M==='sessions'?.5:.9};stroke:${sel?'var(--ink)':(M==='sessions'?'var(--s1)':'var(--surface)')};stroke-width:${sel?2.5:1.25};opacity:${dim?.3:1}"/>`;
    if(rank<3&&W>420)lbl+=`<text x="${px.toFixed(1)}" y="${(py+r+11).toFixed(1)}" text-anchor="middle" class="t-ink2" style="font-size:11px;font-weight:550">${C.n==='United States'?'United States':C.n}</text>`});
  el.innerHTML=`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H.toFixed(0)}" width="${W}" height="${H.toFixed(0)}" role="img" aria-label="Sessions by country"><path d="${land}" style="fill:var(--land);stroke:var(--land-edge);stroke-width:.8" fill-rule="nonzero"/><path d="${water}" style="fill:var(--surface);stroke:var(--land-edge);stroke-width:.8"/>${b}${lbl}</svg>`;
  const svg=el.querySelector('svg');
  svg.addEventListener('mousemove',e=>{const t=e.target.closest('[data-c]');if(!t){untip();return}const c=+t.dataset.c;
    tip(`<div class="h">${R.countries[c].n}</div>${trow('Sessions',fmt(X.cn[c]))}${trow('Bounce rate',pct(sd(X.cb[c],X.cn[c])))}${trow('Conversion',pct(sd(X.cc[c],X.cn[c]),2))}${trow('Revenue',usd(X.cr[c]))}`,e)});
  svg.addEventListener('mouseleave',untip);
  svg.addEventListener('click',e=>{const t=e.target.closest('[data-c]');if(t){untip();setCtry(+t.dataset.c)}});
  const lg=$('#mapLeg');
  if(M==='sessions') lg.innerHTML=`<span>Bubble area = sessions in the period</span>`;
  else{const cs=getComputedStyle(document.documentElement);const stops=[0,1,2,3,4,5,6].map(i=>cs.getPropertyValue('--q'+i).trim()).join(',');
    lg.innerHTML=`<span class="ramp">${M==='conv'?'Conversion':'Bounce'} rate <b class="mono">${pct(lo,M==='conv'?1:0)}</b><i style="background:linear-gradient(90deg,${stops})"></i><b class="mono">${pct(hi,M==='conv'?1:0)}</b></span><span class="ramp"><i style="width:14px;height:14px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--nodata)"></i>Under ${MINN} sessions</span><span>Bubble area = sessions</span>`}
  const t6=order.slice(0,6),mxs=X.cn[order[0]]||1;
  $('#top6').innerHTML=t6.map(c=>`<button class="row" data-c="${c}" aria-pressed="${S.ctry===c}"><span class="nm">${R.countries[c].n}</span><span class="vals mono">${fmt(X.cn[c])}</span></button>`).join('');
}
function setCtry(c){S.ctry=S.ctry===c?-1:c;S.logPage=0;update()}

/* ---------- landing pages table ---------- */
function drawPages(){
  const F=RES.full,avg=sd(F.b,F.n);
  let rows=[...Array(NP).keys()].filter(p=>F.pn[p]>0).map(p=>({p,n:F.pn[p],b:sd(F.pb[p],F.pn[p]),d:sd(F.pd[p],F.pn[p]),c:sd(F.pc[p],F.pn[p]),r:F.pr[p]}));
  const k=S.sort.k,dir=S.sort.dir;rows.sort((a,b)=>k==='p'?dir*R.pages[a.p].localeCompare(R.pages[b.p]):dir*(a[k]-b[k]));
  const mx=Math.max(1,...rows.map(r=>r.n));
  const cols=[['p','Landing page'],['n','Sessions'],['b','Bounce rate'],['d','Avg. time'],['c','Conversion'],['r','Revenue']];
  const th=cols.map(([key,name])=>`<th scope="col" aria-sort="${S.sort.k===key?(dir>0?'ascending':'descending'):'none'}"><button data-sort="${key}">${name}<span aria-hidden="true">${S.sort.k===key?(dir>0?'▲':'▼'):''}</span></button></th>`).join('');
  const body=rows.map(r=>{
    const diff=r.b-avg;let ind='';
    if(Math.abs(diff)>=.03)ind=`<span class="dl ${diff>0?'bad':'good'}" title="${(diff*100>0?'+':'')+(diff*100).toFixed(1)} pts vs overall">${diff>0?'▲':'▼'}</span>`;
    return `<tr><td class="pg">${R.pages[r.p]}</td><td><div class="sbar"><i style="width:${Math.max(2,r.n/mx*110)}px"></i><span class="mono">${fmt(r.n)}</span></div></td><td class="mono">${pct(r.b)}${ind}</td><td class="mono">${mmss(r.d)}</td><td class="mono">${pct(r.c,2)}</td><td class="mono">${usd(r.r)}</td></tr>`}).join('');
  $('#pages').innerHTML=`<thead><tr>${th}</tr></thead><tbody>${body||`<tr><td colspan="6" class="empty">No sessions match these filters.</td></tr>`}</tbody>`;
}

/* ---------- session log ---------- */
const PAGE_SIZE=10;
function drawLog(){
  const idx=RES.full.idx,n=idx.length,pages=Math.max(1,Math.ceil(n/PAGE_SIZE));
  if(S.logPage>=pages)S.logPage=pages-1;
  const start=S.logPage*PAGE_SIZE,rows=[];
  for(let j=start;j<Math.min(n,start+PAGE_SIZE);j++)rows.push(idx[n-1-j]);
  $('#logSub').textContent=`${fmt(N)} sessions in the dataset. ${fmt(n)} match the current filters, newest first.`;
  const head=['Session','Date','Visitor','Source','Country','Device','Landing page','Furthest step','Time','Revenue'];
  $('#log').innerHTML=`<thead><tr>${head.map((h,i)=>`<th scope="col" style="text-align:${i>=8?'right':'left'}">${h}</th>`).join('')}</tr></thead><tbody>${rows.map(i=>{
    const s=A_s[i];return `<tr><td class="mono" style="text-align:left">S${String(i+1).padStart(6,'0')}</td><td style="text-align:left">${dl(A_d[i],1)}</td><td class="mono" style="text-align:left">V${String(A_vi[i]+1).padStart(6,'0')}</td>
    <td style="text-align:left"><span class="dot" style="background:${SCOL[s]};margin-right:7px"></span>${R.src[s]}</td><td style="text-align:left">${R.countries[A_c[i]].n}</td><td style="text-align:left">${R.dev[A_v[i]]}</td>
    <td class="pg" style="text-align:left">${R.pages[A_p[i]]}</td><td style="text-align:left">${R.stages[A_st[i]]==='Sessions'?'Bounced':R.stages[A_st[i]]}</td><td class="mono">${mmss(A_du[i])}</td><td class="mono">${A_r[i]?'$'+A_r[i].toFixed(2):'—'}</td></tr>`}).join('')||`<tr><td colspan="10" class="empty">No sessions match these filters.</td></tr>`}</tbody>`;
  $('#pager').innerHTML=`<span>${n?`Rows ${fmt(start+1)}–${fmt(Math.min(n,start+PAGE_SIZE))} of ${fmt(n)}`:'0 rows'}</span><span class="btns"><button class="ghost" data-pg="-1" ${S.logPage===0?'disabled':''}>Previous</button><span style="align-self:center">Page ${fmt(S.logPage+1)} of ${fmt(pages)}</span><button class="ghost" data-pg="1" ${S.logPage>=pages-1?'disabled':''}>Next</button></span>`;
}

/* ---------- orchestration ---------- */
function drawAll(){
  if(!RES)return;
  drawBar();drawKPIs();drawTrend();drawSources();drawBounce();drawFunnel();drawMap();drawPages();drawLog();
}
function resetAll(){S.r0=D-DEFAULT_LEN;S.r1=D-1;S.dev=-1;S.src.clear();S.ctry=-1;S.logPage=0;update()}

/* events */
$('#devSeg').innerHTML=[['-1','All'],...R.dev.map((d,i)=>[String(i),d])].map(([v,l])=>`<button data-d="${v}">${l}</button>`).join('');
$('#devSeg').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;S.dev=+b.dataset.d;S.logPage=0;update()});
$('#rangeSeg').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;const len=+b.dataset.r;S.r1=D-1;S.r0=D-len;S.logPage=0;update()});
$('#mapSeg').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;S.mapM=b.dataset.m;drawBar();drawMap()});
$('#reset').addEventListener('click',resetAll);
$('#active').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('button');if(!b)return;const w=b.dataset.clear;
  if(w==='range'){S.r0=D-DEFAULT_LEN;S.r1=D-1}else if(w==='src')S.src.delete(+b.dataset.i);else if(w==='ctry')S.ctry=-1;S.logPage=0;update()});
$('#srcList').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-s]');if(b)toggleSrc(+b.dataset.s)});
$('#top6').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-c]');if(b)setCtry(+b.dataset.c)});
$('#pages').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-sort]');if(!b)return;const k=b.dataset.sort;
  if(S.sort.k===k)S.sort.dir*=-1;else{S.sort.k=k;S.sort.dir=k==='p'?1:-1}drawPages()});
$('#pager').addEventListener('click',e=>{const b=e.target.closest('[data-pg]');if(!b)return;S.logPage+=+b.dataset.pg;drawLog()});

let raf=0,lastW=0;
new ResizeObserver(()=>{const w=document.body.clientWidth;if(w===lastW)return;lastW=w;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);raf=requestAnimationFrame(()=>{if(RES){drawTrend();drawFunnel();drawMap()}})}).observe(document.body);
matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').addEventListener('change',()=>RES&&drawMap());
new MutationObserver(()=>RES&&drawMap()).observe(document.documentElement,{attributes:true,attributeFilter:['data-theme']});
update();
})();
</script>
